title: hexmesh validation case
description: validation/<case>/case.json: a validation case's category, references, tags, status, gates and task (decision 0012, amendment 2026-10-30; task 0073); or validation/exports/<consumer>/case.json: an export check's format, consumer, checks and status (decision 0057, task 0182).

kind.description: validation (the default): is the mesh good enough for engineering answers, in OpenFOAM; export: does a mesh arrive intact and usable in another code (decision 0057).

name.description: An export check's case name: its results.json's case, and what recheck and the summaries call it (its directory is the consumer's).

category.description: The strongest reference: V1 exact solution, V2 high-fidelity simulation, V3 experiment, V4 correlation or standard.

key.description: Citation key in docs/references.bib; absent for an analytic solution derived in the case.

source.description: What is compared: the solution, table or data set.

features.description: The hexmesh features the case exercises (decision 0012's fixed list, extended by decision 0050).

toolchain.description: The solver: OpenFOAM, or FEniCSx for a secondary-solver case (decision 0034, task 0077).

conversion.description: How the mesh reaches OpenFOAM: gmshToFoam's flags, and any mesh made otherwise (task 0108).

status.description: A validation case: planned, in progress, accepted, or missed (run to the end, at least one gate missed, the miss explained in RESULTS.md and README; decision 0012 note, 2026-11-18).  An export check: passes or fails, with the reason (decision 0057 rule 2).

format.description: An export check's file format, as Assembly.write writes it.

consumer.description: The code an export check reads the file with, pinned (decision 0057 rule 2).

image.description: The container image, pinned by digest.

checks.description: What an export check asserts, each with its limit: the import (cell count, cell types, group names), the exact answer, and the order (decision 0057 rule 2).

reason.description: Why an export check fails (required then), or what its pass rests on.

notes.description: Optional: a caveat a reader needs before trusting the comparison, e.g. a reference's known mismatch (task 0068).

headline.description: Optional: the result in one line, for the README's validation table, e.g. "reattachment 10.97 D vs the database's 11.03 D (−0.5 %)"; its numbers from RESULTS.md (task 0078).
